title: Authentication and sessions
content: Northstar supports single sign-on through SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect. Multi-factor authentication is required for administrator accounts and optional for editors and viewers. Interactive sessions expire after eight hours, while inactive sessions expire after thirty minutes. Service accounts use scoped API tokens instead of interactive sessions.

title: Data retention and deletion
content: Northstar retains customer conversation transcripts for 30 days by default. Workspace administrators can reduce the transcript retention period, but they cannot extend it beyond 90 days. Security audit logs are retained for 365 days. A verified deletion request removes customer content from active systems within 24 hours and from encrypted backups during the next backup-expiration cycle.

title: Production deployment policy
content: Production releases use a canary deployment that sends 10 percent of traffic to the new version for 30 minutes. The release is rolled back automatically when the canary error rate exceeds 2 percent or p95 latency increases by more than 20 percent. A release engineer must approve promotion to full traffic after the canary checks pass.

title: Knowledge index synchronization
content: Northstar synchronizes connected knowledge sources every 15 minutes. New and updated documents become searchable after the next successful synchronization. When a source document is deleted, Northstar records a tombstone immediately and removes the corresponding chunks from the serving index within one hour. Failed synchronizations are retried with exponential backoff and appear in the workspace activity log.

title: Support incident response
content: A Priority 1 incident is acknowledged within 15 minutes and receives status updates every 30 minutes until mitigation. Priority 2 incidents are acknowledged within two business hours. Customers open incidents through the support portal and should include the workspace identifier, impact summary, start time, and relevant request identifiers.

title: Billing and invoices
content: Northstar issues monthly invoices on the first business day of each month. Standard contracts use net-30 payment terms. Usage above the contracted allowance appears as a separate overage line item on the next invoice. Billing administrators can download invoices and usage details from the workspace billing page.

title: Workspace roles and tenant isolation
content: Northstar provides three workspace roles: viewer, editor, and administrator. Viewers can read published knowledge, editors can create and update content, and administrators manage members, integrations, retention, and billing. Every retrieval request is filtered by workspace and user permissions before ranking so that chunks from another tenant cannot enter the candidate set.

title: Backup and recovery
content: Northstar creates encrypted backups every night and retains them for 35 days. The standard recovery point objective is 24 hours, and the recovery time objective is four hours after a disaster is declared. Restore tests run quarterly, and failures create a Priority 1 operations incident.
